q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
(a) Time left until resolution

NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 earnings release would occur in late August 2026 (Q2 FY2027 ends August 2, 2026). Today is August 18, 2026, meaning the earnings release has likely already occurred or is imminent. Time to resolution: essentially 0 days (or already resolved).

(b) Most likely outcome and why

According to the CURRENT RESEARCH provided, NVIDIA issued forward guidance on May 20, 2026 for Q2 FY2027 revenue of **$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%**. This means the guided range is $89.18 billion to $92.82 billion.

The guidance was issued by management during their Q1 FY2027 earnings report and represents NVIDIA's official expectation for Q2 FY2027. Since we are now at August 18, 2026, and Q2 FY2027 ended on August 2, 2026, the actual results should be known or about to be announced. 

The most likely outcome is that NVIDIA's guidance will fall within or very close to their stated $91.0B ± 2% range.

(c) What would push the value lower?

- Demand weakness or customer inventory corrections beyond what was anticipated in May
- Supply chain disruptions that constrained shipments
- Softening in AI/data center demand (though this seems unlikely given the sector dynamics)
- Unexpected geopolitical impacts on China revenue (though guidance already excluded China data center compute revenue)
- Macro deterioration between May and August that impacted orders

(d) What would push the value higher?

- Stronger-than-expected demand for AI accelerators
- Upside from Data Center segment performing better than anticipated
- Customers accelerating deployments ahead of anticipated schedules
- Higher average selling prices (ASP) than modeled
- Contributions from segments beyond Data Center exceeding expectations

(e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the CURRENT RESEARCH:
- Q2 FY2026 actual revenue: $46.743 billion
- Q2 FY2027 guided revenue: $91.0 billion (±2%)
- This represents approximately 94% year-over-year growth
- Average analyst estimate was $86.84 billion (below guidance)
- Hudson Labs consensus: $91.846 billion (very close to guidance)

NVIDIA has historically provided relatively accurate guidance with actual results typically falling within their ±2% range.

---

Given that:
1. The guidance was formally issued by NVIDIA management ($91.0B ±2%)
2. We are now past the end of Q2 FY2027 (August 2, 2026)
3. The earnings release is imminent or may have already occurred
4. NVIDIA typically delivers within or very close to guidance
5. The research shows analyst consensus aligned with the guidance

The forward guidance amount that NVIDIA will report is almost certainly **$91.0 billion**, with the actual result expected to be within the $89.18B to $92.82B range. The most likely single point is $91.0 billion itself.

Low (10th percentile): 89180000000
Median (50th percentile): 91000000000
High (90th percentile): 92820000000
q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue was released on May 20, 2026, during their Q1 FY2027 earnings report. The company expects revenue to be $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). This guidance excludes any Data Center compute revenue from China [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/), [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/).

This figure is higher than the average analyst estimate of $86.84 billion for Q2 FY2027, according to LSEG [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/). Hudson Labs noted the consensus revenue estimate is $91.846 billion [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors). The guidance implies a 94% year-over-year increase compared to Q2 FY2026 revenue of $46.743 billion [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors).
